title: The Salon Booking System – Appointment Booking for Salons, Barbershops & Spas plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to…
description: The Salon Booking System plugin for WordPress up to version 10.31.16 suffers from an authorization bypass vulnerability. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can overwrite arbitrary user meta fields, including those of administrators, and create bookings attributed to arbitrary users. This vulnerability arises because the plugin does not properly verify user authorization and the booking endpoint's permission check is ineffective when reCAPTCHA is disabled by default.
